verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an official POS UI extensions API for adding custom functionality to the POS interface, with defined targets (tiles, actions, blocks) and runtime APIs such as shopify.storage, shopify.toast and shopify.action.presentModal(). It also provides Shopify CLI scaffolding and direct GraphQL Admin API access from extensions, which together form an official SDK surface to build against. Missing for 10: named SDK packages or client libraries across languages, versioning/reference depth beyond overview snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with it.
